observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

observation.setting: Indoor stage with dark backdrop and wooden floor, performance/class setting
observation.dancers: Group of women, approximately five, dancing together with one central leader visible at the front
observation.formation_and_space: Spread across the stage in a loose staggered line, moving individually while maintaining space
observation.posture: Upright erect torso, slightly arched back, knees flexible, weight shifting between feet with heels and toes articulating
observation.footwork: Rhythmic heel and toe stamping (zapateado) synchronized with the guitar and clapping, intricate foot patterns difficult to detail precisely due to low resolution
observation.arms_and_hands: Arms raised gracefully overhead with curved elbows, wrists rotating outward, hands fluttering and snapping fingers
observation.hips_and_torso: Torso bends side-to-side and arches, hips shifting subtly with weight changes, occasional sharp turns of the body
observation.partnering: None, solo dancing in a group formation
observation.levels_jumps_turns: Full turns on the spot, occasional short weight transfers lifting feet slightly, no high jumps
observation.costume_and_props: Matching dark brown ruffled flamenco skirts, sleeveless tops with decorative embroidery on the chest, hair in buns with floral accessories
observation.cannot_infer: Exact foot articulation, speed of fast zapateado, and intricate finger placement are obscured by low video resolution and camera distance.
